text:
june: Seeing a surge of 429s from prod for a handful of enterprise orgs — started around 10:02 UTC. All affected orgs had a quota snapshot rollback in the console earlier. Anyone else seeing this? :rotating_light:
ops-bot: automated-job: quota-snapshot-rollback completed for snapshot_id=qs_2026_03_18_09:58 by user=maria
deploy-bot: deploy: console-backend v4.12.1 rolled out at 09:59 UTC (change: snapshot rollback endpoint exposed)
sriram: copying logs from quota-enforcer (filtered):
```
2026-03-18T10:02:05Z quota-enforcer[worker-3]: org=org-8292 lookup: snapshot=qs_2026_03_18_09:58 -> policy: not found
2026-03-18T10:02:05Z quota-enforcer[worker-3]: org=org-8292 applied default policy: burst=0, rate=0 -> enforcement=429
2026-03-18T10:02:05Z quota-enforcer[worker-3]: metric=quota.enforced count=123
```
kevin: that log line explains it — fallback default is zeroed burst when snapshot metadata is missing. rollback job removed snapshot pointers for some orgs instead of tagging them as using previous snapshot.
maria: ack — I initiated the rollback to fix a bad snapshot but that job was supposed to re-point to last-known-good. CLI output looked fine but I must have used the wrong flag.
sriram: @kevin can we hotfix by re-assigning snapshots for affected orgs? I can run a batch rebind if you give me the safe snapshot id.
kevin: I'm building a quick script to rebind from metadata backups. Suggest also enabling a temporary permissive override so production apps don't keep getting 429s while we fix mapping.
maria: snapshot backup id is qs_backup_2026_03_17_2350 — verified contains expected per-org quotas.
kevin: running plan: (1) enable global permissive override for 15m (2) run rebind script on affected orgs (3) restart quota-sync worker to pick up mappings (4) remove override.
sriram: please paste the commands when ready.
kevin: running commands now:
```
# enable permissive override
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/overrides" -d '{"type":"quota-permissive","ttl":900}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
# rebind snapshots (dry-run first)
python tools/rebind_snapshots.py --backup qs_backup_2026_03_17_2350 --orgs-file /tmp/affected_orgs.txt --apply
```
ops-bot: override created id=ovr_5889 ttl=900 by kevin
kevin: rebind script completed: 42 orgs updated, 0 errors. Restarting quota-sync worker.
kevin: quota-sync restart: systemctl restart quota-sync.service -> status: active.
sriram: telemetry shows 429 rate dropping back to baseline over the last 2m — grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/quotas/429s?org=all
june: traffic looks healthy again, error rates back to normal. Great job.
maria: I'm going to file a postmortem and add a safety check to the rollback job to prevent nulling snapshot pointers. Also updating console UX language around "repoint vs delete".
kevin: follow-ups: add unit test to rollback workflow, add e2e that verifies org->snapshot mapping preserved, and add circuit-breaker to prevent rollback unless dry-run OK.
sriram: adding oncall action item to update runbook: if rollback ran in console, check backup binds and watch 429 dashboard for 20m.
june: resolved for now. Leaving this thread open for PM and postmortem notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
